#!/bin/bash

sudo apt-get clean
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
apt-get update

sudo apt install -y software-properties-common unzip git wget vim
sudo /usr/bin/add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa && /usr/bin/add-apt-repository ppa:git-core/ppa 
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y gettext gcc make libz-dev libexpat1-dev libssl-dev \
    libcurl4-openssl-dev \
    python3.11 python3.11-distutils

wget https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py; python3 get-pip.py
python3.11 -m pip install virtualenv

apt-get update

git clone https://github.com/securefederatedai/openfl.git
